corrections.issue: Misstates which period had no pullback: Cham says the market has now (summer 2024) gone almost two months without a pullback greater than 50bp, and that this looks very similar to 2017 because the same structural effects cause the same outcome. The claim instead dates the two-month stretch to 2017.
corrections.fix: Cham: heavy index vol supply means the market will find it very hard to break down any time soon; the S&P has not had a pullback larger than 50bp in almost two months, which resembles 2017, because the same structural flows are producing the same outcome.

corrections.issue: Attribution of the probability: the coin-flip estimate for something happening over the next two to three years is presented by Cham as what people in the US government and others in the know say, which he adopts; the claim presents it as his own independent judgement. The 30% downturn is his estimate.
corrections.fix: Cham: Nvidia, now the biggest company, was the epicentre of the Taiwan fear in 2022, and people in the US government and others in the know see roughly a coin flip that something happens in the next two to three years; with Nvidia at the centre, such an event could cause about a 30% market downturn, which is how narrow breadth matters.

completeness_estimate: 0.75 - the first reader caught the main vol-supply, 0DTE, breadth, calendar-path, populism, Trump-trade and gold-call ideas; it missed many supporting mechanisms (index-to-constituent causality, why structured products grew, dealer hedging loop, reflexive liquidity), several caveats and the Biden-replacement and Europe sub-arguments.
